title: Install, upgrade, remove and purge offline
goal: Execute a scoped two-package lifecycle and verify configuration retention.
challenge: Using only the protected fixture archives, install and verify the report, upgrade it, retain a deliberate configuration customization through remove, then purge it. Preview every APT transaction and reject unrelated changes.

steps.command: w=/home/learner/ll-discovery-7; test "$(id -un)" = learner && test ! -e "$w" && test ! -L "$w" && mkdir -m 0700 -- "$w" && cd -- "$w" && test "$(df -Pk . | awk 'NR==2 {print $4}')" -ge 65536
steps.explanation: Create a fresh private workspace; stop on collision or insufficient space.
steps.expected: Exact learner path, no existing entry, at least64MiB free.

steps.command: guard() { local links; test "$(pwd -P)" = /home/learner/ll-discovery-7 && test ! -L /home/learner/ll-discovery-7 && test "$(stat -c %U .)" = learner && links=$(sudo find . -type l -print -quit) && test -z "$links"; }; guard
steps.expected: No path substitution; guest root can override guest safeguards.

steps.command: unrelated() { dpkg-query -W -f='${binary:Package}\t${Version}\t${db:Status-Status}\n' | awk '$1!="ll-discovery-data" && $1!="ll-discovery-report"'; }; unrelated > before.tsv; sudo sha256sum /etc/sudoers.d/learning-lab > sudo.before; id learner > learner.before; scope_ok() { guard && unrelated > after.tsv && cmp before.tsv after.tsv && sudo sha256sum -c sudo.before && id learner > learner.after && cmp learner.before learner.after; }; scope_ok
steps.explanation: Retain unrelated package and learner/sudo evidence before any transaction.
steps.expected: Protected unrelated state captured; stop on mismatch.

steps.command: apt_base=(apt-get --assume-yes --no-download --no-install-recommends -oDir::Cache::archives="$w/cache" -oDir::Etc::sourcelist="$w/no-sources.list" -oDir::Etc::sourceparts="$w/no-sources.d"); plan() { guard && sha256sum -c cache.sha256 > cache-check.txt && sudo env LC_ALL=C "${apt_base[@]}" -s "$@" > plan.txt 2>&1 && awk '/^(Reading package lists|Building dependency tree|Reading state information|Correcting dependencies)\.\.\.( Done)?$/ {next} /^Note, selecting .ll-discovery-(data|report). instead of .\/opt\/learning-lab\/package-fixtures\/archives\/ll-discovery-(data_1[.]0-1|report_1[.][01]-1)_all[.]deb.$/ {next} /^The following (additional packages will be installed|NEW packages will be installed|packages will be upgraded|packages will be REMOVED):$/ {next} /^  / {for(i=1;i<=NF;i++){p=$i;sub(/\*$/,"",p);if(p!="ll-discovery-data" && p!="ll-discovery-report")bad=1} next} /^[0-2] upgraded, [0-2] newly installed, ([0-2] reinstalled, )?[0-2] to remove and [0-9]+ not upgraded\.$/ {summary++;next} /^[0-2] not fully installed or removed\.$/ {next} $1=="Inst" || $1=="Conf" || $1=="Remv" || $1=="Purg" {n++;if(NF<2 || ($1!="Purg" && NF<3) || ($2!="ll-discovery-data" && $2!="ll-discovery-report"))bad=1;next} /^[[:space:]]*$/ {next} {bad=1} END {exit (bad || summary!=1 || n>4)}' plan.txt && cat plan.txt; }; d=/opt/learning-lab/package-fixtures/archives/ll-discovery-data_1.0-1_all.deb; r1=/opt/learning-lab/package-fixtures/archives/ll-discovery-report_1.0-1_all.deb; r2=/opt/learning-lab/package-fixtures/archives/ll-discovery-report_1.1-1_all.deb; guard && mkdir -m 0700 cache no-sources.d && : > no-sources.list && cp -- "$d" "$r1" "$r2" cache/ && grep '  archives/' /opt/learning-lab/package-fixtures/SHA256SUMS | sed 's|  archives/|  cache/|' > cache.sha256 && sha256sum -c cache.sha256
steps.explanation: Define the same root-context APT configuration for preview/execution. Every plan may name only the two fixture identities; stop otherwise.
steps.expected: Protected archives, no acquisition; review the printed operation list even after its allowlist check.

steps.command: plan install --no-remove "$d" "$r1" && scope_ok && sudo env LC_ALL=C "${apt_base[@]}" install --no-remove "$d" "$r1" && scope_ok && ll-discovery-report
steps.explanation: Use explicit local files; no-download alone would not bound solver changes.
steps.expected: Both fixtures installed, report1.0-1 and known data; unrelated package/policy checks match.

steps.command: plan install --no-remove "$r2" && scope_ok && sudo env LC_ALL=C "${apt_base[@]}" install --no-remove "$r2" && scope_ok && ll-discovery-report
steps.explanation: Upgrade just the report; the dependency stays at1.0-1.
steps.expected: Report1.1-1; only the two allowed fixture names appear in plans.

steps.command: guard && printf 'format=custom\n' | sudo tee /etc/ll-discovery-report.conf && plan remove ll-discovery-report && scope_ok && sudo env LC_ALL=C "${apt_base[@]}" remove ll-discovery-report && scope_ok && cat /etc/ll-discovery-report.conf
steps.explanation: Removal retains a declared configuration file; do not assume all files are removed.
steps.expected: Executable absent, custom configuration retained, report in config-files state.

steps.command: plan purge ll-discovery-report && scope_ok && sudo env LC_ALL=C "${apt_base[@]}" purge ll-discovery-report && plan purge ll-discovery-data && scope_ok && sudo env LC_ALL=C "${apt_base[@]}" purge ll-discovery-data && scope_ok && test ! -e /etc/ll-discovery-report.conf
steps.explanation: Purge the report before the dependency. No broad autoremove.
steps.expected: Both fixtures absent and configuration gone; unrelated packages unchanged.

hints: Preview and execution must share identity, locale, arguments and configuration.
Installing a local archive can still involve dependency decisions; inspect names.
Remove and purge differ when the package declares configuration files.
review: Actual versions/output, planned and completed actions, configuration retention/purge, unrelated state unchanged.
coverage: LPIC-1 v5.0 102.4 partial actual install/upgrade/remove/purge. Self-reviewed, unscored; not complete objectives.
